subtitle: 호텔 프런트에 모닝콜 부탁하기
desc: 호텔 프런트 데스크에 아침 모닝콜 시간을 요청하고 확인하는 회화

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Good evening. Could I arrange a wake-up call for tomorrow morning, please?
turns.ko: 안녕하세요. 내일 아침 모닝콜 부탁드려도 될까요?

turns.speaker: Front Desk
turns.en: Of course. What time would you like the call?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Six thirty, please. I have an early flight.

turns.speaker: Front Desk
turns.en: Six thirty. And which room is that?

turns.speaker: Front Desk
turns.en: Thank you, Mr. Kim. Would you like one call or a second reminder ten minutes later?
turns.ko: 감사합니다, 김 씨. 한 번만 할까요, 아니면 10분 뒤에 한 번 더 할까요?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Just one call is fine. Can you also tell me the breakfast hours again?
turns.ko: 한 번이면 충분합니다. 조식 시간도 다시 알려 주시겠어요?

turns.speaker: Front Desk
turns.en: Breakfast is from six thirty to ten. The restaurant is on the second floor.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Perfect. If I do not answer, will you call again?
turns.ko: 완벽합니다. 제가 안 받으면 다시 전화해 주시나요?

turns.speaker: Front Desk
turns.en: Yes. We will try twice. Have a good night.
turns.ko: 네. 두 번 시도하겠습니다. 좋은 밤 되세요.

tips.en: Could I arrange a wake-up call for tomorrow morning?
What time would you like the call?
Would you like one call or a second reminder?
tips.ko: 한 번만 할까요, 아니면 한 번 더 할까요?

tips.en: If I do not answer, will you call again?
tips.ko: 제가 안 받으면 다시 전화해 주시나요?
